g.text: Qwen3-8B: future loss and available evidence
Left: two separately executed model protocols; positive gain is better. Full strong controls are in the tables.
Right: base-bound acquisition traces. Hatched bars are offline source-only feasible references, not online methods.
E coverage is not model E accuracy or an F objective. Calendars/lead times are not independent weather samples.
